news.text: 🚨🔥 "#Juventus pushes forward in contacts overnight for #Kessié: the bianconero club does not want to lose its pole position and has made steps forward with the midfielder's agents. A possible breakthrough is expected in short order: both #Spalletti and #Massara have called him personally in recent hours."[Fabrizio Romano via @juventusinsidernews]
#Juve#David Brings #ZirkzeeThe new center-forwardThe Canadian joining #Cholo (who is blocking Sørloth). All in on the Dutchman.[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]
#Kessié, #Juve-#Roma DuelFriedkin in actionThe Ivorian is a free agent. #Spalletti is waiting for him, but Gasp is trying to enter the race.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#SØRLOTHTHE #DAVID CARD#Juve is increasing closer to #Kessié and finds a possible key for the Norwegian striker. The idea is a swap of loans with #Atlético. For the Canadian, there was also an inquiry from #Fiorentina. Following #Roma's entry, they are pushing for the Ivorian midfielder even without the exit of #Koopmeiners. The #Yildiz-Sinner meeting at the JMedical.[Front Page TuttoSport]

ℹ️❗️"#Juventus, second striker situation:🇳🇴 #AtléticoMadrid has put up a wall for #Sørloth. They are still grappling with the Julian #Alvarez issue and, for the moment, are not opening up to the Norwegian's exit - in fact, they aren't even considering it;🇫🇷 Thus, even on recent hours, the bianconeri have kept contacts alive with Mateta's entourage, who is leaving #CrystalPalace and is currently evaluating other offers;🇳🇱 The situation of #Zirkzee must always be monitored, he is an outcast at #ManchesterUnited with several interested clubs, even though he is not the center-forward #Spalletti is looking for."[Alfredo Pedullà - SportItalia via @juventusinsidernews]
#Juventus has kept contacts alive with #Mateta who has a couple of other proposals. On the restricted list, there is always #Zirkzee who has different characteristics.[Alfredo Pedullà]
🛑#Cabal continues to have doubts about #Bologna: an agreement in principle with #Juventus, #Tedesco approves the choice but the Colombian defender continues to take his time 🇨🇴[Daniele Longo]

#Juve, the latest updates 👇-#Kessié continues to give priority to the bianconeri. -#Zirkzee remains booked. The striker rejected #AstonVilla for the bianconeri.-#Massara and #Carnevali are very active on the outgoing mercato.-#Miretti signs today, in Istanbul, with #Besiktas.[Eleonora Trotta]
#Parma are working to sign a new centre-back: #DiegoCarlos (Fenerbahce) is the main target. Daniele #Rugani (Juventus) is Plan B. #transfers[Nico Schira]
Expected today medicals and signing for Fabio #Miretti with #Besiktas. Deal on loan with the option to buy for a total package of €14M. #transfers #Juventus[Nico Schira]

GJustjuve ⁉️🇨🇮 "In the coming hours, new contacts between #Juventus and #Kessié, who has always given priority to the bianconeri. #Miretti's exit would technically be enough, but not economically due to the constraints of the UEFA settlement agreement." [Gianluca Di… https://t.me/GJustjuve/71955🇨🇦😴 "#David is the ideal exit for #Juventus: his €7M net salary would allow them to free up space for #Kessié and #Zirkzee. At the moment, however, there is no advanced negotiation."[Gianluca Di Marzio via @Juventus_Reborn]

⁉️🇨🇮 "In the coming hours, new contacts between #Juventus and #Kessié, who has always given priority to the bianconeri. #Miretti's exit would technically be enough, but not economically due to the constraints of the UEFA settlement agreement."[Gianluca Di Marzio via @Juventus_Reborn]

👀🚨 "#Roma met with #Kessié's agent, reaffirming their interest: #Gasperini is an admirer of his, but he has always given priority to #Juventus, #Spalletti called him multiple times. The bianconeri will persist, but both are still missing something to close the deal. La Vecchia Signora needs another exit, and his name is #David. Should he leave, they will try to close the deals for the Ivorian and #Zirkzee."[Di Marzio - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇮🔛 "#Juventus is proceeding with #Kessié, #Spalletti wants him and there is a draft agreement for two years and an option for a third one. The offer was €4M + bonuses to reach €5M, while he wants €5M guaranteed and, in the end, it will close at €4.5M + bonuses. Parties are very, very close. The #Roma situation has faded: #Gasperini is not asking for a midfielder but an attacking winger. Perhaps this rumor was put out by his entourage to make the bianconeri hurry up."[Nicolò Schira - Juventibus via @juventusinsidernews]

🇹🇷⁉️ Today has been a dense day of evaluations regarding #Yildiz's condition. The medical staff is trying to understand how to proceed, whether to put him under the knife or opt for another therapy. The decision is by no means simple, every detail can make a difference in the healing process and the subsequent competitive recovery. In any case, the feeling is that he will be sidelined for about 2 or 3 months.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
++ #Juventus is after Ali #Camara ++Belgian winger, born in 2008, currently playing for Jong #Genk. Parties are at work to close the deal 🔐⚪️⚫️@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

🇨🇮🆙 "#Juventus continues to talk with #Kessié and his agents, and now they must make a decision. #Massara had new contacts today on the player's side to keep him warm and ready. He has waited, now it is up to the bianconeri to make the move. Being a free agent, everything can happen in 5 minutes, so keep your antennas up."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀🆙 "The plane for #Miretti is ready for tomorrow morning, heading toward Istanbul. The deal is a loan with an option to buy that could become an obligation. A plane is also ready to welcome some new signings, to unlock certain transfer sagas and also to carry out some exits that are currently stalled - but above all, to add something in the midfield."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
